description: Find ski resorts worldwide by name, country or distance. Returns at most 20 matches and does not expose the bulk resort index.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code such as 'CH' or 'FR' (case-insensitive). Any other value is ignored, so do not pass a country name.

limit.description: Maximum number of resorts to return, 1 to 20. Defaults to 10.

near.description: A point to rank results by distance from, nearest first. Each match then includes distanceKm.

query.description: Resort name or part of one, such as 'Zermatt' (up to 80 characters). Omit to list resorts by country or distance.

name: search_resorts
title: Search resorts
